label: What sign-up and Forgot password do when the portal cannot send email
description_nl: verify_later (default): sign-up still works, the account is marked unconfirmed and asked to confirm once mail works; Forgot password tells people to ask the owner. closed: sign-up waits until the owner sets up email. A door gated on something not set up is a door nobody comes through (2026-09-17).
weight_basis: Platform access primitive, no business content. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
